candidates.claim: Broken access control: can_read returns True for any truthy requester without comparing requester to owner, so any authenticated requester can read a non-public document owned by someone else. The stated contract permits access only for public documents or an authenticated requester equal to owner; the owner parameter is never used in the returned expression.

checkout_total does not validate quantity: it directly returns price * quantity with no negative-quantity check, so a negative quantity yields a negative total instead of raising ValueError as the contract requires.
